pages.text: [#](53341a)Leonard is an old, dark name — the black goat of the sabbath, the lord at the crossroads of infernal commerce. His Shade does not wander freely; he must be forced into the world through the Witch's Cauldron.[#]()
pages.title: Shade of Leonard

pages.text: [#](53341a)Heat and fill the Witch's Cauldron. Dissolve **Nether Wart**, a **Tear of the Goddess**, **Diamond Vapour**, a **Diamond**, and a **Nether Star** in that order — by dropping each into the bowl or by sneak-stirring it in by hand.[#]()
pages.title: Summoning

pages.text: [#](53341a)Then hold a **Witches' Hat** and use it on the cauldron. No Gunpowder. The altar must hold at least 10,000 power. The Shade forms half-made and untouchable for a few moments before he draws his full strength together.[#]()

[#](53341a)Leonard is neutral until struck, for he reckons no mortal thing a threat. Provoked, no blow but your own hand will mark him — arrows and thrown things simply glance away — and even your strikes he shrugs down to almost nothing.[#]()
pages.title: Behaviour

pages.text: [#](53341a)He answers with the witch's own signs flung as fire and force, and lays the **Mortal Coil** on every soul nearby: a quiet curse that kills when it lifts, unless the Shade is slain first, which frees everyone it touched.[#]()

[#](53341a)Below half strength he calls **Lost Souls** in waves. Green souls take harm from anything; red resist all but fire and explosions; black resist all but magic and potions. While any remain, Leonard cannot be harmed.[#]()
[#](53341a)Wounded near to death he swells to a giant, harder still to fell.[#]()

[#](53341a)A defeated Shade drops **Leonard's Urn**, a vessel of considerable infernal standing. Its use is concrete enough: use it to open the diamond focus inventory, then place one splash, gas, or liquid brew in each available slot.[#]()
pages.title: Reward

pages.text: [#](53341a)The urn does not cast directly from the hand; the Mystic Branch's four urn glyphs call the matching stored focus without spending it. Crafting two urns together combines their capacity and stored focuses, up to four slots.[#]()
